title: A multi-subunit autophagic capture complex facilitates degradation of ER-stalled MHC class I in pancreatic cancer.
model: PaTu8902 PDAC, hCRISPRi-v2 (dCas9-KRAB), surface MHC-I FACS
contrast: MHC-I high vs low sort bin (1 vs 1)
paper_calls: NFXL1 named as the screen hit; no gene table published
barcs_calls: 165 genes at FDR 0.10 (216 against the control null); NLRC5, TAP1, B2M, HLA-A in the MHC-I low bin
named_hits: NFXL1 rank 455 enriched in the high bin (by p), FDR 0.52; TEX264, NBR1 not significant
verdict: BARCS recovers the MHC-I pathway (NLRC5 #1, TAP1, B2M, HLA-A) but not the paper's named hit NFXL1, whose signal rests on one of five guides. One library per bin, so the FDR is screening-level without replicate variance.
